source: replayed from published dataset (Mendeley nmr8pjx8d8, CC BY 4.0)
scenario: Tamper case. The device sat in open air: the dataset's ambient series is replayed as if it were concrete. Signatures are valid; the curing check flags it.

dataset.attribution: Utepov et al., Complex Maturity Method for Estimating the Concrete Strength Based on Curing Temperature, Ambient Temperature and Relative Humidity, Applied Sciences 11(16):7712, 2021; dataset doi 10.17632/nmr8pjx8d8.1, CC BY 4.0

context.note: chainId and ledger are part of every signed digest; re-run the replay against the deployed ledger before appending elsewhere

pourStartRule: replay: block time 1791763260 - dataset duration 2419200 s - 3600 s, so all readings are in the past

message.root: leaves in reading order, pairs hashed with node, odd last node carried up
message.digest: sha256(abi.encode("POURPROOF_BATCH_V1", uint256 chainId, address ledger, bytes32 pourId, uint64 counter, uint64 fromTs, uint64 toTs, bytes32 root))
message.signature: P-256 ECDSA over digest, RFC 6979 nonce, low-s
message.proof: per reading: sibling hashes from its leaf to the batch root (OpenZeppelin MerkleProof.verify with BatchMessage.node)

anomaly.reference: packages/core anomaly() on the signed readings vs the dataset's ambient series
